targets.rawSql: WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol,s.period_seconds) s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch,s.side,s.reason,s.probability,s.model_version FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active ORDER BY s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch DESC), valid AS (SELECT l.* FROM latest l JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=l.symbol AND m.period_seconds=l.period_seconds AND m.model_version=l.model_version WHERE l.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND l.reason='ok' AND l.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < l.candle_epoch + 2 * l.period_seconds) SELECT count(DISTINCT symbol) AS value FROM valid

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol,s.period_seconds) s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch,s.side,s.reason,s.probability,s.model_version FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active ORDER BY s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch DESC), valid AS (SELECT l.* FROM latest l JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=l.symbol AND m.period_seconds=l.period_seconds AND m.model_version=l.model_version WHERE l.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND l.reason='ok' AND l.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < l.candle_epoch + 2 * l.period_seconds) SELECT count(*) AS value FROM valid

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol,s.period_seconds) s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch,s.side,s.reason,s.probability,s.model_version FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active ORDER BY s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch DESC), valid AS (SELECT l.* FROM latest l JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=l.symbol AND m.period_seconds=l.period_seconds AND m.model_version=l.model_version WHERE l.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND l.reason='ok' AND l.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < l.candle_epoch + 2 * l.period_seconds) SELECT count(*) AS value FROM valid WHERE side='CALL'

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol,s.period_seconds) s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch,s.side,s.reason,s.probability,s.model_version FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active ORDER BY s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch DESC), valid AS (SELECT l.* FROM latest l JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=l.symbol AND m.period_seconds=l.period_seconds AND m.model_version=l.model_version WHERE l.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND l.reason='ok' AND l.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < l.candle_epoch + 2 * l.period_seconds) SELECT count(*) AS value FROM valid WHERE side='PUT'

WITH latest AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.symbol,s.period_seconds) s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch,s.side,s.reason,s.probability,s.model_version FROM indicator_signals s JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=s.symbol AND a.active ORDER BY s.symbol,s.period_seconds,s.candle_epoch DESC), valid AS (SELECT l.* FROM latest l JOIN indicator_model_versions m ON m.symbol=l.symbol AND m.period_seconds=l.period_seconds AND m.model_version=l.model_version WHERE l.side IN ('CALL','PUT') AND l.reason='ok' AND l.probability IS NOT NULL AND extract(epoch from now()) < l.candle_epoch + 2 * l.period_seconds) SELECT v.symbol, a.name AS ativo, CASE v.period_seconds WHEN 300 THEN 'M5' WHEN 900 THEN 'M15' ELSE 'H1' END AS periodo, v.side AS sinal, 'APROVADO' AS validacao, round((v.probability * 100)::numeric,1) AS prob_call_pct, to_timestamp(v.candle_epoch + v.period_seconds) AS vela_fechada, to_timestamp(v.candle_epoch + 2 * v.period_seconds) AS horizonte_fim, v.model_version AS modelo, o.interim_side AS direcao_provisoria, CASE WHEN o.interim_side='EMPATE' THEN 'NEUTRO' WHEN o.interim_side=v.side THEN 'A FAVOR' WHEN o.interim_side IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE 'CONTRA' END AS indicacao_provisoria, to_timestamp(o.observed_at) AS observado_em, perf.amostras_confirmadas, round(perf.acertos_confirmados_pct::numeric,1) AS acertos_confirmados_pct FROM valid v JOIN indicator_symbols a ON a.symbol=v.symbol LEFT JOIN indicator_live o ON o.symbol=v.symbol AND o.period_seconds=v.period_seconds AND o.signal_epoch=v.candle_epoch AND o.observed_at >= extract(epoch from now()) - 120 LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS amostras_confirmadas, 100.0 * avg(h.correct::integer) AS acertos_confirmados_pct FROM indicator_signals h WHERE h.symbol=v.symbol AND h.period_seconds=v.period_seconds AND h.model_version=v.model_version AND h.correct IS NOT NULL) perf ON true ORDER BY a.name,v.period_seconds
